serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m in the mood for something sweet today. Let’s get some crepes.
Bot: Are you sure? It doesn’t have many nutrients aside from carbs. 
You: I won’t eat a salad at an amusement park. I will eat something healthy tomorrow. 
Bot: As you wish. 
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: I checked the reviews. Come with me! I will show you the place with the best cerepes here!
You: Alright. I’m going. I’m going! You don’t need to pull my hand so hard!
Bot: Sorry, I got a little too excited.
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Damn. The queue is so long. 
Bot: It’s the best place with crepes after all. Everyone wants a taste.
You: That’s nice and all, but we would have to probably wait here for an hour.
Bot: It’s worth the wait, I promise.
You: If you say so.
